lines.say: So yesterday, I go to the shop, and there is a man, and he has a dog, and the dog… no wait, first I… em…
lines.zh: 所以昨天，我去商店，然後有一個男的，他有一隻狗，然後那隻狗……不對，等等，我先……呃……

lines.say: …Sorry, what happened in the end?
lines.zh: ……抱歉，所以最後怎麼了？

lines.say: That story was hilarious. In my head. By the time I got to the end, everyone was looking at their phones.
lines.zh: 那個故事超好笑，在我腦袋裡的時候。等我講到結尾，大家都在滑手機了。

lines.say: A good story isn't about perfect grammar. It's about order, timing, and a punchline.
lines.zh: 好故事不是靠完美的文法，是靠順序、節奏和笑點。

board.cta: 把糗事講得好笑・12 句

lines.say: Hi everyone, I'm Neev! Today: twelve sentences for telling a story that people actually want to hear.
lines.zh: 哈囉大家，我是 Niamh 老師！今天教你講一個大家真的想聽的故事的十二句話。
lines.cap: Hi everyone, I'm Niamh! Today: twelve sentences for telling a story that people actually want to hear.

lines.say: How to start, how to build it up, how to land the ending, and how to react to other people's stories.
lines.zh: 怎麼開頭、怎麼鋪陳、怎麼收尾，還有怎麼回應別人的故事。

lines.say: Part one: hook them.
lines.zh: 第一段：勾住大家。

lines.say: The first sentence decides if people put their phones down.
lines.zh: 第一句話決定大家會不會放下手機。

scenes.label: No. 1
scenes.phrase: You'll never guess what happened to me yesterday.
scenes.meaning: 你絕對猜不到我昨天發生什麼事
scenes.note: You'll never guess ＝ 你絕對猜不到

lines.say: You'll never guess what happened to me yesterday.
This sentence makes everyone curious. It's a promise of a good story.
lines.zh: 這句話讓大家好奇，承諾了一個好故事。

lines.say: Now you have to deliver! No pressure.
lines.zh: 現在你得說到做到！沒壓力。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: You'll never guess what happened to me yesterday.

scenes.label: No. 2
scenes.phrase: So, I was standing in the queue at Tesco, minding my own business…
scenes.meaning: 我那時在 Tesco 排隊，自己顧自己……
scenes.note: was standing ＝ 過去進行式：當時正在

lines.say: Then set the scene. Use was plus i-n-g for the background.
lines.zh: 接著交代場景。用 was 加 ing 描述背景。

lines.say: So, I was standing in the queue at Tesco, minding my own business…
I was standing describes what was happening when the story began.
lines.zh: I was standing 描述故事開始時正在發生的事。

lines.say: Minding my own business means doing nothing special, not bothering anyone. Something is about to happen!
lines.zh: minding my own business 是自顧自的、沒招惹誰。代表事情要發生了！

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: So, I was standing in the queue at Tesco, minding my own business…

scenes.label: No. 3
scenes.phrase: Out of nowhere, this huge dog ran up and grabbed my sandwich.
scenes.meaning: 突然冒出一隻大狗衝過來，叼走我的三明治
scenes.note: Out of nowhere ＝ 突然、毫無預警

lines.say: Then the action. Switch to simple past for the events.
lines.zh: 接著是動作。事件用簡單過去式。

lines.say: Out of nowhere, this huge dog ran up and grabbed my sandwich.
Out of nowhere means suddenly, without warning.
lines.zh: out of nowhere 是突然、毫無預警。

lines.say: Background in was plus i-n-g. Events in simple past. That's the secret of every English story.
lines.zh: 背景用 was＋ing，事件用過去式，這就是所有英文故事的秘訣。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Out of nowhere, this huge dog ran up and grabbed my sandwich.

scenes.title: Build it up
scenes.sub: 鋪陳：放慢、加細節、製造懸念

lines.say: Part two: build it up.
lines.zh: 第二段：鋪陳。

lines.say: Don't rush to the end. The middle is where people start laughing.
lines.zh: 不要急著講到結局，中間才是大家開始笑的地方。

scenes.label: No. 4
scenes.phrase: And I'm not joking, it was the size of a small horse.
scenes.meaning: 我不是開玩笑，那隻狗跟小馬一樣大
scenes.note: I'm not joking ＝ 我沒開玩笑

lines.say: And I'm not joking, it was the size of a small horse.
Exaggerating is part of the fun. Everyone knows it wasn't really a horse.
lines.zh: 誇張是樂趣的一部分，大家都知道那不是真的馬。

lines.say: I'm not joking, when you clearly are, makes it even funnier.
lines.zh: 明明在誇張還說「我沒開玩笑」，更好笑。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: And I'm not joking, it was the size of a small horse.

scenes.label: No. 5
scenes.phrase: So I just stood there, thinking: what do I do now?
scenes.meaning: 所以我就站在那裡，心想：現在怎麼辦？
scenes.note: stood there, thinking ＝ 站在那裡想著

lines.say: Then share what was in your head.
lines.zh: 接著說你當時腦袋在想什麼。

lines.say: So I just stood there, thinking: what do I do now?
Telling people your thoughts lets them feel the moment with you.
lines.zh: 說出你當時的想法，讓大家跟你一起身歷其境。

lines.say: Pause before what do I do now. Let them wonder too.
lines.zh: 在 what do I do now 前停一下，讓大家也一起猜。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: So I just stood there, thinking: what do I do now?

scenes.label: No. 6
scenes.phrase: And then, to make things even worse, the owner turned around and said…
scenes.meaning: 然後，更糟的是，狗主人轉過來說……
scenes.note: to make things even worse ＝ 更糟的是

lines.say: And when things get worse, say so. It builds tension.
lines.zh: 事情越來越糟時，就明說。這會製造張力。

lines.say: And then, to make things even worse, the owner turned around and said…
To make things even worse tells people: wait, there's more.
lines.zh: to make things even worse 告訴大家：等一下，還沒完。

lines.say: Stop right there for a second. Everyone will lean in.
lines.zh: 在這裡停一秒，大家會往前靠。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: And then, to make things even worse, the owner turned around and said…
Let's try that story again.
lines.zh: 我們重講一次這個故事。

lines.say: You'll never guess what happened to me yesterday. So, I was standing in the queue at Tesco, minding my own business…
lines.zh: 你絕對猜不到我昨天發生什麼事。我那時在 Tesco 排隊，自己顧自己……

lines.say: Uh oh.
lines.zh: 喔喔。

lines.say: Out of nowhere, this huge dog ran up and grabbed my sandwich. And I'm not joking, it was the size of a small horse.
lines.zh: 突然冒出一隻大狗衝過來，叼走我的三明治。我不是開玩笑，那隻狗跟小馬一樣大。

lines.say: No way!
lines.zh: 不會吧！

lines.say: He's listening. Now the ending.
lines.zh: 他在聽了。現在講結局。

lines.say: Part three: land the punchline.
lines.zh: 第三段：笑點落地。

lines.say: The punchline is the funny last line. Say it short, and then stop.
lines.zh: punchline 是最後那句好笑的話。說短一點，說完就停。

scenes.label: No. 7
scenes.phrase: He looked at me and said: he doesn't usually eat ham.
scenes.meaning: 他看著我說：牠通常不吃火腿的
scenes.note: He said ＋ 直接引述 ＝ 最生動的說法

lines.say: He looked at me and said: he doesn't usually eat ham.
Quote the exact words. Direct speech is always funnier than he told me that.
lines.zh: 直接引述原話。直接引語永遠比 he told me that 好笑。

lines.say: And change your voice a little when you quote someone. Act it!
lines.zh: 引述別人時稍微換個聲音，演出來！

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: He looked at me and said: he doesn't usually eat ham.

scenes.label: No. 8
scenes.phrase: I didn't know whether to laugh or cry.
scenes.meaning: 我不知道該笑還是該哭
scenes.note: whether to A or B ＝ 該 A 還是 B

lines.say: Then add your reaction.
lines.zh: 接著說你的反應。

lines.say: I didn't know whether to laugh or cry.
Whether to laugh or cry means it was so bad it was funny.
lines.zh: whether to laugh or cry 是糟到好笑的程度。

lines.say: A classic way to end a disaster story.
lines.zh: 這是災難故事的經典結尾。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: I didn't know whether to laugh or cry.

scenes.label: No. 9
scenes.phrase: Anyway, long story short, I never went back to that Tesco.
scenes.meaning: 總之，長話短說，我再也沒去過那家 Tesco
scenes.note: long story short ＝ 長話短說

lines.say: And if you're losing them, jump to the end.
lines.zh: 如果大家快失去興趣了，就直接跳到結尾。

lines.say: Anyway, long story short, I never went back to that Tesco.
Long story short means I'll skip the details and give you the ending.
lines.zh: long story short 是跳過細節直接講結果。

lines.say: Anyway is the magic word that brings any story back to the point.
lines.zh: anyway 是把任何故事拉回重點的魔法字。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Anyway, long story short, I never went back to that Tesco.

scenes.title: React
scenes.sub: 回應別人的故事：讓對方講得開心

lines.say: Part four: react to other people's stories.
lines.zh: 第四段：回應別人的故事。

lines.say: Half of a good chat is being a good audience.
lines.zh: 好的聊天，一半是當個好聽眾。

lines.say: Stop! You're making that up!
Make something up means invent a story. Said with a big smile, it's a compliment.
lines.zh: make something up 是編故事。笑著說，這是讚美。

lines.say: It means: your story is so good, it can't be true.
lines.zh: 意思是：你的故事好到不像真的。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Stop! You're making that up!

scenes.label: No. 11
scenes.phrase: That reminds me of the time I locked myself out in my pyjamas.
scenes.meaning: 這讓我想起有一次我穿著睡衣被鎖在門外
scenes.note: That reminds me of the time ＝ 這讓我想起有一次

lines.say: Then share a story back.
lines.zh: 接著回一個你的故事。

lines.say: That reminds me of the time I locked myself out in my pyjamas.
That reminds me of the time is how stories become a chain. Everyone takes a turn.
lines.zh: That reminds me of the time 讓故事一個接一個，每個人輪流講。

lines.say: But wait until they've finished. Don't steal their moment.
lines.zh: 但要等對方講完，不要搶人家的風頭。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: That reminds me of the time I locked myself out in my pyjamas.

scenes.label: No. 12
scenes.phrase: I can't believe that actually happened to you.
scenes.meaning: 真不敢相信這真的發生在你身上

lines.say: And the warmest reaction of all.
lines.zh: 最溫暖的回應。

lines.say: I can't believe that actually happened to you.
Actually here adds surprise. It really happened!
lines.zh: 這裡的 actually 加強驚訝：竟然真的發生了！

lines.say: Your friend will want to tell you every story they have.
lines.zh: 你朋友會想把所有故事都講給你聽。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I can't believe that actually happened to you.
He looked at me and said: he doesn't usually eat ham.
lines.zh: 他看著我說：牠通常不吃火腿的。

lines.say: Stop! You're making that up!
lines.zh: 不會吧！你是編的吧！

lines.say: I'm not! I didn't know whether to laugh or cry.
lines.zh: 我沒有！我不知道該笑還是該哭。

lines.say: That reminds me of the time a seagull stole my chips in Howth.
lines.zh: 這讓我想起有一次在 Howth，一隻海鷗搶走我的薯條。

lines.say: No way! I can't believe that actually happened to you.
lines.zh: 不會吧！真不敢相信這真的發生在你身上。

lines.say: And now it's his turn. That's a great night at the pub.
lines.zh: 現在換他講了。這就是 Pub 裡美好的夜晚。

scenes.title: Only in Ireland
scenes.sub: 愛爾蘭限定：聽故事時的兩句

lines.say: One more thing! Two Irish reactions to a great story.
lines.zh: 還有加碼！愛爾蘭人聽到好故事時的兩種反應。

lines.say: When something is so funny it hurts, Irish people say this.
lines.zh: 好笑到肚子痛時，愛爾蘭人會這樣說。

lines.say: I was in stitches!
Stitches are a pain in your side, from laughing too much.
lines.zh: stitches 是笑太多側腹的抽痛。

lines.say: And when a story sounds too wild to be true, they say this.
lines.zh: 故事誇張到不像真的時，他們會這樣說。

lines.say: Go 'way!
It's short for go away, but it means: no way, I don't believe you! Tell me more!
lines.zh: 這是 go away 的縮寫，但意思是：少來了，我不信！再多說一點！

lines.say: Go 'way!

scenes.title: All together
scenes.sub: 總複習：整個故事講一遍

lines.say: Now tell the whole story with me. Say my lines!
lines.zh: 現在跟我一起把整個故事講一遍。跟我一起唸！

lines.say: You'll never guess what happened to me yesterday.
lines.zh: 你絕對猜不到我昨天發生什麼事。

lines.say: Go on.
lines.zh: 說吧。

lines.say: So I just stood there, thinking: what do I do now? And then, to make things even worse, the owner turned around and said…
lines.zh: 所以我就站在那裡，心想：現在怎麼辦？然後，更糟的是，狗主人轉過來說……

lines.say: What? What did he say?
lines.zh: 什麼？他說什麼？

lines.say: He doesn't usually eat ham.
lines.zh: 牠通常不吃火腿的。

lines.say: Go 'way! I was in stitches!
lines.zh: 少來了！我笑到肚子痛！

items: You'll never guess what happened to me yesterday.
So, I was standing in the queue at Tesco, minding my own business…
Out of nowhere, this huge dog ran up and grabbed my sandwich.
And I'm not joking, it was the size of a small horse.
So I just stood there, thinking: what do I do now?
And then, to make things even worse, the owner turned around and said…
He looked at me and said: he doesn't usually eat ham.
I didn't know whether to laugh or cry.
Anyway, long story short, I never went back to that Tesco.
That reminds me of the time I locked myself out in my pyjamas.
I can't believe that actually happened to you.

lines.say: Great storytelling! Order, timing, punchline.
lines.zh: 說得太好了！順序、節奏、笑點。

lines.say: Here are all twelve. Screenshot them, and tell your own disaster story this week.
lines.zh: 十二句都在這裡。截圖下來，這週講一個你自己的糗事。

board.cta: 打開 BinBin，每天用一則新聞練英文

lines.say: I'm Neev. Open BinBin, and practise English with one news story every day.
lines.zh: 我是 Niamh 老師。打開 BinBin，每天用一則新聞練英文。
lines.cap: I'm Niamh. Open BinBin, and practise English with one news story every day.

lines.say: And keep an eye on your sandwiches. See you next time. Bye!
lines.zh: 還有，顧好你的三明治。下一課見，Bye！
